title: GTA Online
headline: GTA Online
subtitle: Business Rivalries Event
content:
Put your criminal enterprises to work all throughout September during the Business Rivalries Event, steering the invisible hand of the free market in your favor with profitable bonuses for Executives, Bikers, Gunrunners, and Nightclub Owners.

Seize growth opportunities and corner the market across the next four weeks to earn extra GTA$ and RP while also capturing rare, branded in-game apparel along the way — as well as a free business property available each week in September.
